format: co-op posting with 'X is not required, but is a plus' / 'not required but nice to have' / 'X not required'
note: R2.4: 'Python is not required, but is a plus' and 'MATLAB not required but nice to have' are preferred, even inside Requirements. 'Lean manufacturing not required' is negation_after with no plus clause: no group, so the resume's 5S is not found. 'CAD experience required (SolidWorks preferred)': the postfix cue after SolidWorks is 'preferred'; the earlier 'required' attaches to no skill -> SolidWorks preferred. 'Familiarity with GD&T is required' -> required. Perks: CNC and 3D printing excluded (resume CNC not found). Resume: MATLAB really negated; 'with no off-the-shelf fixtures', 'zero data dropouts', 'without new equipment' are not negations.

Manufacturing Engineering Co-op, Summer 2027
Hollis Medical Devices, Minneapolis, MN

The Role
- Support process development for catheter assembly lines
- Write validation protocols and test reports for new equipment
- Assist with process FMEA updates and line layouts

Requirements
- Currently pursuing a B.S. in Mechanical, Biomedical or Manufacturing Engineering
- Familiarity with GD&T is required
- CAD experience required (SolidWorks preferred)
- Python is not required, but is a plus
- MATLAB not required but nice to have
- Lean manufacturing not required
- Must be available May through August

Perks
- Paid housing stipend and a summer mentor
- Access to our machine shop, where co-ops get hands-on time with CNC and 3D printing
